create_Wav2Vec2AsrCriterion: create a Wav2Vec2AsrCriterion instance with a RecipeModel and optional WerCalculator for ASR training
call_Wav2Vec2AsrCriterion_compute_loss: call the Wav2Vec2AsrCriterion with a Seq2SeqBatch and MetricBag to compute CTC loss and batch size
prepare_metric_bag_add_asr_metrics: prepare a MetricBag by calling prepare_metric_bag to register ASR-specific metrics for tracking
forward_with_logits_decode_outputs: run forward_with_logits on a batch to get loss, logits, and layout for WER computation during validation
process_metric_values_WER: process accumulated metric values by calling process_metric_values to finalize WER calculator results
